example.text: His degenerate behavior at the party shocked everyone.
example.translationZh: 他在聚会上的堕落行为让所有人都感到震惊。

definitionEn: v. reduce the level of land, as by erosion\nv. lower the grade of something; reduce its worth
definitionZh: v. (使)降级, (使)退化

example.text: Heavy logging can degrade the environment and threaten wildlife.
example.translationZh: 过度伐木会破坏环境并威胁野生动物。

definitionEn:
n. a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality
n. a specific identifiable position in a continuum or series or especially in a process
n. a measure for arcs and angles
n. the highest power of a term or variable
definitionZh: n. 程度, 度数, 学位, 度\n[医] 度, 程度

example.text: She was tired to a certain degree, but she kept working.
example.translationZh: 她有些累了，但仍继续工作。

definitionEn:
n. time during which some action is awaited
n. the act of delaying; inactivity resulting in something being put off until a later time
v. cause to be slowed down or delayed
v. act later than planned, scheduled, or required
definitionZh: n. 耽搁, 迟滞\nv. 耽搁, 延迟\n[计] 延迟, 延时

example.text: The flight was delayed by two hours because of the heavy storm.
example.translationZh: 由于猛烈的暴风雨，航班延误了两个小时。

definitionEn: s. extremely pleasing to the sense of taste\ns. capable of arousing desire
definitionZh: a. 令人快乐的, 美味的, 使人愉快的

example.text: The bakery is famous for its delectable pastries, which sell out before noon.
example.translationZh: 这家面包店以其美味的糕点闻名，不到中午就卖光了。

definitionEn: n. a person appointed or elected to represent others\nv. transfer power to someone\nv. give an assignment to (a person) to a post, or assign a task to (a person)
definitionZh: n. 代表\nvt. 委派...为代表

example.text: The manager decided to delegate authority to her team so they could make decisions faster.
example.translationZh: 经理决定把权力下放给她的团队，以便他们能更快地做出决定。

definitionEn: v. remove or make invisible
definitionZh: vt. 删除\n[计] 删除

example.text: Please delete the old files from your computer before installing the new software.
example.translationZh: 安装新软件之前，请从电脑中删除旧文件。

definitionEn: s. carefully thought out in advance
definitionZh: a. 深思熟虑的, 故意的, 从容的\nv. 仔细考虑

example.text: The fire was not an accident; it was a deliberate attempt to destroy the evidence.
example.translationZh: 这场火灾并非意外，而是蓄意销毁证据的行为。

definitionEn:
a. exquisitely fine and subtle and pleasing; susceptible to injury
s. marked by great skill especially in meticulous technique
s. easily broken or damaged or destroyed
s. easily hurt
definitionZh: a. 细致优雅的, 微妙的, 美味的\n[医] 柔弱的

example.text: The ecosystem relies on a delicate balance between predators and prey.
example.translationZh: 生态系统依赖于捕食者与猎物之间微妙的平衡。

definitionEn: n. variety of sweet eating apples
definitionZh: a. 美味的

example.text: Grandma made a delicious apple pie for the family gathering.
example.translationZh: 奶奶为家庭聚会做了一个美味的苹果派。

definitionEn: n. nonpayment of a debt when due\nn. a tendency to be negligent and uncaring\nn. an antisocial misdeed in violation of the law by a minor
definitionZh: n. 行为不良, 失职\n[经] 毁约, 怠工, 旷职

example.text: The city launched a new program aimed at reducing juvenile delinquency in low-income neighborhoods.
example.translationZh: 该市启动了一项新计划，旨在减少低收入社区的青少年犯罪。

definitionEn: n. a usually brief state of excitement and mental confusion often accompanied by hallucinations
definitionZh: n. 精神错乱, 说谵语状态, 狂热\n[医] 谵妄, 发狂, 妄想

example.text: The high fever left the patient in a state of delirium, muttering about people who were not there.
example.translationZh: 高烧使病人陷入谵妄状态，喃喃自语着并不存在的人。

definitionEn:
v. deliver (a speech, oration, or idea)
v. bring to a destination, make a delivery
v. utter (an exclamation, noise, etc.)
v. save from sins
definitionZh: vt. 递送, 陈述, 释放, 发表, 引渡, 投递, 交付\n[经] 交运

example.text: The professor will deliver a speech on climate change at the conference tomorrow.
example.translationZh: 教授明天将在会议上就气候变化发表演讲。

definitionEn:
n. the act of delivering or distributing something (as goods or mail)
n. the event of giving birth
n. the voluntary transfer of something (title or possession) from one party to another
n. the act of delivering a child
definitionZh: n. 递送, 交付, 分娩, 交货, 引渡\n[化] 交货额

example.text: The restaurant offers free delivery service for orders over $30.
example.translationZh: 这家餐厅为超过30美元的订单提供免费送货服务。

definitionEn: v be false to; be dishonest with
definitionZh: vt. 迷惑, 蛊惑

example.text: The advertisement deluded many consumers into believing the product was completely safe.
example.translationZh: 这则广告哄骗了许多消费者相信该产品完全安全。

definitionEn: v. fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid
definitionZh: n. 大洪水, 泛滥\nvt. 使泛滥

example.text: After the announcement, the office received a deluge of requests for information.
example.translationZh: 公告发布后，办公室收到了大量索取信息的请求。

definitionEn: n. the political orientation of those who favor government by the people or by their elected representatives\nn. a political system in which the supreme power lies in a body of citizens who can elect people to represent them
definitionZh: n. 民主政治, 民主主义\n[法] 民主, 民主政治, 民主政体

example.text: The town meeting is a good example of participatory democracy in action.
example.translationZh: 镇民大会是参与式民主付诸实践的一个很好的例子。

definitionEn: v. destroy completely\nv. defeat soundly
definitionZh: vt. 毁坏, 破坏, 粉碎

example.text: The city plans to demolish the old factory to make room for a new park.
example.translationZh: 市政府计划拆除那座旧工厂，为一座新公园腾出空间。

definitionEn:
n. a show of military force or preparedness
n. a public display of group feelings (usually of a political nature)
n. proof by a process of argument or a series of proposition proving an asserted conclusion
n. a visual presentation showing how something works
definitionZh: n. 示范, 实证\n[医] 示教, 实物教授

example.text: The students held a peaceful demonstration to demand better facilities.
example.translationZh: 学生们举行了一场和平示威，要求改善设施。

definitionEn: n. the act of refusing to comply (as with a request)\nn. the act of asserting that something alleged is not true\nn. (psychiatry) a defense mechanism that denies painful thoughts
definitionZh: n. 否认\n[法] 否定, 否认, 拒绝接受

example.text: She is still in denial about her son's addiction.
example.translationZh: 她仍然拒绝承认她儿子上瘾的事实。

definitionEn: n. a group of religious congregations having its own organization and a distinctive faith\nn. a class of one kind of unit in a system of numbers or measures or weights or money
definitionZh: n. 名称, 教派, 面额\n[经] 票面金额, 名称, (度量衡)

example.text: The church belongs to a small Methodist denomination.
example.translationZh: 这座教堂属于一个小的卫理公会教派。

definitionEn: v. speak out against\nv. announce the termination of, as of treaties\nv. give away information about somebody
definitionZh: vt. 告发, 抨击, 谴责\n[法] 谴责, 斥责, 告发

example.text: The mayor publicly denounced the vandals who damaged the historic monument.
example.translationZh: 市长公开谴责破坏历史纪念碑的破坏者。

definitionEn:
s. permitting little if any light to pass through because of denseness of matter
s. hard to pass through because of dense growth
s. having high relative density or specific gravity
s. slow to learn or understand; lacking intellectual acuity
definitionZh: a. 密集的, 浓厚的

example.text: The hikers lost their way in the dense forest.
example.translationZh: 徒步旅行者在茂密的森林里迷了路。

definitionEn: n. a person qualified to practice dentistry
definitionZh: n. 牙科医生\n[医] 牙医师

example.text: You should see a dentist if the toothache doesn't go away.
example.translationZh: 如果牙痛一直不好，你应该去看牙医。

definitionEn: v. leave\nv. go away or leave
definitionZh: vi. 离开, 出发, 背离, 违反, 去世

example.text: The train departs from platform three at nine o'clock.
example.translationZh: 火车九点从三号站台出发。

definitionEn: n. a specialized division of a large organization\nn. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)\nn. a specialized sphere of knowledge
definitionZh: n. 部门, 系, 机关\n[医] 部, 科

example.text: She works in the sales department of a large company.
example.translationZh: 她在一家大公司的销售部工作。

definitionEn: a. of or relating to a department
definitionZh: a. 部门的, 各部的, 分科的

example.text: All department heads must attend the departmental meeting on Friday.
example.translationZh: 所有部门主管必须参加周五的部门会议。

definitionEn: a. relying on or requiring a person or thing for support, supply, or what is needed\ns. contingent on something else\na. (of a clause) unable to stand alone syntactically as a complete sentence
definitionZh: n. 依赖他人者\na. 依赖的, 从属的

example.text: Many elderly people are dependent on their families for daily care.
example.translationZh: 许多老年人在日常照护上依赖家人。

definitionEn: v show in, or as in, a picture\nv give a description of\nv make a portrait of
definitionZh: vt. 描述, 描写

example.text: The painting depicts a peaceful village scene at sunset.
example.translationZh: 这幅画描绘了日落时分宁静的乡村景象。

definitionEn: v use up (resources or materials)
definitionZh: vt. 耗尽, 使衰竭\n[医] 排除, 减少

example.text: Intensive farming can quickly deplete the soil of essential nutrients.
example.translationZh: 集约化农业会很快耗尽土壤中的必需养分。

definitionEn: n. the act of decreasing something markedly\nn. the state of being depleted
definitionZh: n. 消耗, 耗尽, 放血\n[医] 排除, 缺失(液体), 衰竭[状态](由于缺液)

example.text: Overfishing has led to the rapid depletion of fish stocks in the region.
example.translationZh: 过度捕捞导致该地区鱼类资源迅速枯竭。

definitionEn: v. express strong disapproval of\nv. regret strongly
definitionZh: vt. 悲悼, 哀叹, 对...深感遗憾

example.text: World leaders gathered to deplore the violence that had erupted in the capital.
example.translationZh: 各国领导人齐聚一堂，谴责在首都爆发的暴力事件。

definitionEn:
n. the phenomenon of sediment or gravel accumulating
n. money deposited in a bank or some similar institution
n. money given as security for an article acquired for temporary use
n. a payment given as a guarantee that an obligation will be met
definitionZh: n. 存款, 定金, 堆积物\nvt. 存放, 堆积\nvi. 沉淀

example.text: We had to pay a deposit of two hundred dollars before they would hold the apartment for us.
example.translationZh: 他们答应为我们保留那套公寓之前，我们不得不支付两百美元的定金。

definitionEn:
n. a mental state characterized by a pessimistic sense of inadequacy and a despondent lack of activity
n. a long-term economic state characterized by unemployment and low prices and low levels of trade and investment
n. sad feelings of gloom and inadequacy
n. a period during the 1930s when there was a worldwide economic depression and mass unemployment
definitionZh: n. 不景气, 消沉, 沮丧, 洼地\n[医] 抑郁[症], 阻抑, 压低, 凹, 窝, 衰退, 俯角

example.text: Many people suffer from depression during the winter months.
example.translationZh: 许多人在冬季会患上抑郁症。

definitionEn: v. take away possessions from someone\nv. keep from having, keeping, or obtaining\nv. take away
definitionZh: vt. 剥夺, 使丧失\n[法] 剥夺, 剥夺, 夺去

example.text: The new law could deprive citizens of their right to privacy.
example.translationZh: 新法律可能会剥夺公民的隐私权。

definitionEn:
n. the extent downward or backward or inward
n. degree of psychological or intellectual profundity
n. (usually plural) the deepest and most remote part
n. (usually plural) a low moral state
definitionZh: n. 深度, 深处, 深奥\n[计] 深度

example.text: The report examines the causes of climate change in depth.
example.translationZh: 这份报告深入探讨了气候变化的原因。

definitionEn:
n. someone authorized to exercise the powers of sheriff in emergencies
n. an assistant with power to act when his superior is absent
n. a member of the lower chamber of a legislative assembly (such as in France)
n. a person appointed to represent or act on behalf of others
definitionZh: n. 副手，代理人

example.text: She was promoted to deputy manager after three years with the company.
example.translationZh: 在公司工作三年后，她被提升为副经理。

definitionEn: n. a person without a home, job, or property\ns. failing in what duty requires
definitionZh: a. 被抛弃了的, 无主的, 玩忽职守的\nn. 遗弃物, 被遗弃的人, 玩忽职守者

example.text: The city plans to demolish the derelict building on the corner.
example.translationZh: 市政府计划拆除街角那栋废弃的建筑。

definitionEn: v. move downward and lower, but not necessarily all the way
definitionZh: vi. 下降, 世代相传, 屈尊, 袭击\nvt. 下降

example.text: She carefully descended the stairs in the dark.
example.translationZh: 她在黑暗中小心地下楼梯。

definitionEn:
n. a movement downward
n. the act of changing your location in a downward direction
n. the kinship relation between an individual and the individual's progenitors
n. a downward slope or bend
definitionZh: n. 降落, 家系, 侵袭, 血统\n[医] 下降, 世代, 血统

example.text: The hikers slowed down as they began the steep descent into the valley.
example.translationZh: 徒步者们在开始陡峭下坡进入山谷时放慢了脚步。

definitionEn: n. a statement that represents something in words\nn. the act of describing something\nn. sort or variety
definitionZh: n. 描述, 说明, 种类\n[经] 说明书(物品), 品名种类, 货物名称

example.text: The job description lists the main duties and required skills for the position.
example.translationZh: 这份职位描述列出了该岗位的主要职责和所需技能。

phrase.translationZh: 职位描述；工作职责说明

definitionEn: n. arid land with little or no vegetation\nv. leave behind
definitionZh:
n. 沙漠, 应得的赏罚, 功劳
a. 沙漠的, 不毛的
vt. 放弃, 遗弃, 擅离
vi. 逃掉

example.text: After the shipwreck, the sailors lived on a desert island for months.
example.translationZh: 船只失事后，水手们在一个荒岛上生活了几个月。

definitionEn: v. be worthy or deserving
definitionZh: vt. 该得到, 值得\nvi. 应得报答

example.text: After all his hard work, he deserves a chance to lead the project.
example.translationZh: 在他付出这么多努力之后，他值得一个领导这个项目的机会。

definitionEn: v. assign a name or title to\ns. appointed but not yet installed in office
definitionZh: vt. 指定, 指明, 称呼\na. 已选出而未上任的

example.text: The committee will designate a successor before the current director retires.
example.translationZh: 委员会将在现任主任退休前指定一位继任者。

definitionEn: n. a person who devises plots or intrigues
definitionZh: n. 设计者, 谋划者, 制图者\n[计] 设计员

example.text: She works as a fashion designer in Paris.
example.translationZh: 她在巴黎做时装设计师。

definitionEn: a. worth having or seeking or achieving\ns. worthy of being chosen especially as a spouse
definitionZh: a. 令人想望的, 可取的

example.text: The new policy is intended to make affordable housing a desirable option for young families.
example.translationZh: 这项新政策旨在让经济适用房成为年轻家庭的理想选择。

definitionEn:
n. the feeling that accompanies an unsatisfied state
n. an inclination to want things
n. something that is desired
v. feel or have a desire for; want strongly
definitionZh: n. 欲望, 要求\nvt. 想要, 请求\nvi. 渴望

example.text: She has a strong desire to travel around the world.
example.translationZh: 她有一个强烈的环游世界的愿望。

definitionEn: n. a piece of furniture with a writing surface and usually drawers or other compartments
definitionZh: n. 书桌, 办公桌, 工作台

example.text: She asked the receptionist at the front desk for a room key.
example.translationZh: 她向前台接待员要了一把房间钥匙。

definitionEn: s. crushed by grief
definitionZh: a. 荒凉的

example.text: After the war, the village was a desolate landscape with no living soul in sight.
example.translationZh: 战争过后，这个村庄成了一片荒凉的景象，看不到一个活人。

definitionEn: n. a state in which all hope is lost or absent\nn. the feeling that everything is wrong and nothing will turn out well\nv. abandon hope; give up hope; lose heart
definitionZh: n. 绝望, 失望\nvi. 绝望

example.text: After losing his job and his home, he sank into deep despair.
example.translationZh: 在失去工作和住所之后，他陷入了深深的绝望。

definitionEn:
n an official report (usually sent in haste)
n the property of being prompt and efficient
n killing a person or animal
n the act of sending off something
v send away towards a designated goal
definitionZh: v. 派遣\nn. 派遣

example.text: The officer was ordered to despatch a report to headquarters immediately.
example.translationZh: 这名军官奉命立即向总部发送一份报告。

definitionEn:
n. a person who is frightened and in need of help
s. desperately determined
s. (of persons) dangerously reckless or violent as from urgency or despair
s. showing extreme courage; especially of actions courageously undertaken in desperation as a last resort
definitionZh: a. 不顾一切的, 危急的, 令人绝望的, 极渴望的

example.text: After weeks without rain, the farmers were desperate for water.
example.translationZh: 几周没有下雨后，农民们极度渴望水源。

definitionEn: v look down on with disdain
definitionZh: vt. 轻视

example.text: She despised him for lying to her family.
example.translationZh: 她因为他对家人撒谎而鄙视他。

definitionEn: n. the ultimate goal for which something is done
definitionZh: n. 目的地, 目标, 目的\n[计] 目的文件, 目的单元

example.text: After a long flight, we finally reached our destination.
example.translationZh: 经过长途飞行，我们终于到达了目的地。

definitionEn: v. decree or designate beforehand
definitionZh: vt. 注定, 预定

example.text: She always felt she was destined for a life on the stage.
example.translationZh: 她一直觉得自己注定要过舞台生活。

definitionEn: n. an event (or a course of events) that will inevitably happen in the future\nn. the ultimate agency regarded as predetermining the course of events (often personified as a woman)
definitionZh: n. 命运, 定数

example.text: She believed that hard work and determination would allow her to shape her own destiny.
example.translationZh: 她相信努力和决心能让她掌握自己的命运。

definitionEn: a. causing destruction or much damage
definitionZh: a. 毁灭性的, 破坏的, 有害的\n[医] 破坏的, 毁坏的

example.text: The storm was so destructive that it flattened entire neighborhoods.
example.translationZh: 这场风暴破坏力极强，把整个街区夷为平地。

definitionEn: v. cause to become detached or separated; take off\nv. separate (a small unit) from a larger, especially for a special assignment\nv. come to be detached
definitionZh: vt. 使分离, 分遣\n[机] 摘下, 分离, 卸下

example.text: You can detach the hood from the jacket if the weather gets warm.
example.translationZh: 如果天气变暖，你可以把兜帽从夹克上拆下来。

definitionEn:
n. an isolated fact that is considered separately from the whole
n. a small part that can be considered separately from the whole
n. extended treatment of particulars
n. a crew of workers selected for a particular task
definitionZh:
n. 细节, 详情
vt. 详述, 选派
vi. 画详图
[计] 详细数据

example.text: The report describes the safety procedures in detail.
example.translationZh: 这份报告详细描述了安全程序。

definitionEn: s. developed or executed with care and in minute detail
definitionZh: a. 详细的, 复杂的\n[法] 详细的, 详尽的

example.text: The committee prepared a detailed report on the causes of the accident.
example.translationZh: 委员会就事故原因准备了一份详细的报告。

definitionEn: n. true confidential information
definitionZh: n. 详细资料；细节（detail的复数）

example.text: Please send me the details of the meeting by email.
example.translationZh: 请通过电子邮件把会议的详细资料发给我。

definitionEn: v deprive of freedom; take into confinement\nv stop or halt\nv cause to be slowed down or delayed
definitionZh: vt. 扣留, 扣押, 耽搁\n[法] 拘留, 扣押, 留住

example.text: The police can detain a suspect for up to 24 hours without charge.
example.translationZh: 警方未经指控最多可拘留嫌疑人24小时。

definitionEn: n. a police officer who investigates crimes\nn. an investigator engaged or employed in obtaining information not easily available to the public
definitionZh: n. 侦探\na. 侦探的

example.text: The detective examined the crime scene for fingerprints.
example.translationZh: 侦探检查了犯罪现场以寻找指纹。

definitionEn: v. try to prevent; show opposition to
definitionZh: vt. 制止, 吓住, 威慑

example.text: Heavy fines are intended to deter drivers from speeding.
example.translationZh: 高额罚款旨在阻止司机超速行驶。

definitionEn: n. a surface-active chemical widely used in industry and laundering\nn. a cleansing agent that differs from soap but can also emulsify oils and hold dirt in suspension\ns. having cleansing power
definitionZh: n. 清洁剂\n[化] 洗涤剂

example.text: She added a scoop of detergent to the washing machine.
example.translationZh: 她往洗衣机里加了一勺洗衣液。

definitionEn: v. become worse or disintegrate
definitionZh: v. (使)恶化

example.text: Without proper maintenance, the old bridge will deteriorate rapidly.
example.translationZh: 如果没有适当的维护，这座旧桥将迅速恶化。

definitionEn: n. the act of determining the properties of something, usually by research or calculation\nn. the quality of being determined to do or achieve something; firmness of purpose\nn. deciding or controlling something's outcome or nature
definitionZh: n. 决心, 果断\n[化] 判定; 测定

example.text: She trained every morning with determination, hoping to qualify for the national team.
example.translationZh: 她每天早上都坚定地训练，希望能入选国家队。

definitionEn: v dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
definitionZh: vt. 厌恶, 憎恨

example.text: She detests having to work on weekends.
example.translationZh: 她讨厌周末还得工作。

definitionEn: n. a damage or loss
definitionZh: n. 损害, 损害物\n[法] 损害, 伤害, 危害

example.text: He worked late every night, to the detriment of his health.
example.translationZh: 他每天晚上工作到很晚，损害了自己的健康。

definitionEn: s (sometimes followed by `to') causing harm or injury
definitionZh: a. 有害的

example.text: Lack of sleep can be detrimental to your health.
example.translationZh: 睡眠不足会对你的健康有害。

definitionEn: v. overwhelm or overpower
definitionZh: vt. 毁坏\n[法] 使荒废, 毁灭, 掠夺

example.text: The hurricane devastated the coastal region, destroying thousands of homes.
example.translationZh: 飓风摧毁了沿海地区，毁坏了数千所房屋。

definitionEn:
v cause extensive destruction or ruin utterly
v overwhelm or overpower
s making light of
s wreaking or capable of wreaking complete destruction
s physically or spiritually devastating; often used in combination
definitionZh: a. 毁灭性的, (非正式)很好的, 引人注目的

example.text: The earthquake was a devastating blow to the small community.
example.translationZh: 这场地震对这个小型社区是一个毁灭性的打击。

definitionEn:
n. act of improving by expanding or enlarging or refining
n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
n. a recent event that has some relevance for the present situation
n. a district that has been developed to serve some purpose
definitionZh: n. 发展\n[化] 展开

example.text: The government has implemented new policies to promote economic development.
example.translationZh: 政府已实施新政策以促进经济发展。

definitionEn: n. a will disposing of real property\nn. (law) a gift of real property by will\nv. give by will, especially real property
definitionZh: vt. 设计, 发明, 图谋, 遗赠给\nn. 遗赠

example.text: The engineers devised a plan to reduce energy consumption in the factory.
example.translationZh: 工程师们制定了一项计划，以减少工厂的能源消耗。

definitionEn:
v. destroy completely
v. enjoy avidly
v. eat immoderately
v. eat greedily
definitionZh: vt. 吞食, 挥霍, 吞没

example.text: She devoured the novel in a single afternoon, unable to put it down.
example.translationZh: 她一个下午就如饥似渴地读完了那本小说，爱不释手。

definitionEn: v. determine or distinguish the nature of a problem or an illness through a diagnostic analysis\nv. subject to a medical analysis
definitionZh: v. 诊断

example.text: The doctor used several tests to diagnose the disease early.
example.translationZh: 医生通过多项检查来及早诊断这种疾病。

definitionEn: n. a drawing intended to explain how something works; a drawing showing the relation between the parts\nv. make a schematic or technical drawing of that shows interactions among variables or how something is constructed
definitionZh: n. 图表；图解

example.text: The teacher asked us to draw a diagram of the water cycle.
example.translationZh: 老师让我们画一张水循环的示意图。

definitionEn:
n. the face of a timepiece; graduated to show the hours
n. the control on a radio or television set that is used for tuning
n. the circular graduated indicator on various measuring instruments
n. a disc on a telephone that is rotated a fixed distance for each number called
definitionZh: n. 刻度盘, 钟面, 转盘\nv. 拨

example.text: She picked up the phone and dialed his number.
example.translationZh: 她拿起电话拨了他的号码。

definitionEn: n. the usage or vocabulary that is characteristic of a specific group of people
definitionZh: n. 方言, 同源语

example.text: The novel is written in a regional dialect that reflects the speech of the local villagers.
example.translationZh: 这部小说是用反映当地村民口语的地区方言写成的。

definitionEn: n. a conversation between two persons\nn. the lines spoken by characters in drama or fiction\nn. a literary composition in the form of a conversation between two people
definitionZh: n. 对话\nvi. 对话\nvt. 用对话表达

example.text: The two countries agreed to open a dialogue on trade and environmental policy.
example.translationZh: 两国同意就贸易和环境政策开启对话。

definitionEn: n. the length of a straight line passing through the center of a circle and connecting two points on the circumference\nn. a straight line connecting the center of a circle with two points on its perimeter (or the center of a sphere with two points on its surface)
definitionZh: n. 直径\n[医] 直经, 径

example.text: The circle has a diameter of ten centimeters.
example.translationZh: 这个圆的直径是十厘米。
